SYG got a good start and got lots of frags on start... but we managed to fight back and by getting few quad's and making single man attacks we got the frags needed and won the round. But still SYG played very good. GG dm2! - L-FU"
=== DM3 === FU: 196 - SYG: 45


"Dm3 was our map and this one we played on Inet's server. We got a first rl, but SYG got all the powerups, still we managed to get control of RA and get next quad's. Few SYG players bored some RL's at the beginning of the round and we almost too easily got control of the map. SYG had few very good attacks to quad and RA but we managed to keep our positions quite well. GG dm3! - L-FU"
